A has a strong full-width headline at the top, but the bullets are staggered on no shared edge and in reverse order, supporting copy interrupts the list, the circle brushes the 'Wild honey' line, the legal text floats loose mid-left, the can is detached below the circle, and the logo pill is oversized at the bottom.
